name: toolkit
description: Opinionated Claude Code plugins, maintained next to the rest of the toolkit.

plugins.name: conventions
plugins.description: Strict code-design, C#/.NET, TypeScript, Angular, HTML/SCSS, accessibility and commit conventions, with Gmf, scss-solutions and toolkit-release integrations loaded only where a project depends on them. Hooks load the owning skills before an edit, flag banned patterns after it and format C# whitespace; projects tune them in .claude/conventions.json.
